items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: He and Andy Gibson and Billy Moore, Jr., William Moore, Jr.

ctx.x: And of course we went to the Famous Door shortly after that, and I sent for Billy. I said, "I want you to come in and arrange for me," you know. Oh, it was a ridiculous deal. Something like $15.00 an arrangement or something like that. And Billy was not playing in the band, he was just writing for it. He and Andy Gibson and Billy Moore, Jr., William Moore, Jr. Oh, and there was another guy by the name of Bud Estes who -- they were all writing for the band. Benny Carter contributed a couple of things. But we were…
